shared_requirements.S1: Exact source edition, instrument/codebook, raw carrier, source-access/host/purpose and retention limits; metadata inspection and response processing permissions distinguished.
shared_requirements.S2: Complete source-native item/unit/applicability inventory at declared scope; every column/occurrence mapped or explicitly excluded/held; exact question/response meanings, special values, routing/forms, country/time, design/weights/estimand.
shared_requirements.S3: Prospective meaningful target/conditioner/joint roles, finite discovery/recursive law and bounds, expected work and coverage accounting; preserve nonwinning/minority/negative/unvisited cases; no automatic all-pairs or copied historical frontier.
shared_requirements.S4: Production runtime composes existing byte custody, projection/catalog, independent current decision resolver, workload admission and Route B/I03/I05/Batch; authority and real source semantics are inputs, not generated test grants.
shared_requirements.S5: Actual persisted empirical objects and F1-F4 analytical products: marginals/conditionals in admitted directions, higher-order same-carrier joints/clouds, recursive alternatives, support/risk/uncertainty and typed negatives.
shared_requirements.S6: Claim-specific validation where constitutive, learned release/publication/exact dereference and lifecycle/dependency/rebuild; direct lawful empirical routes remain available; full product/service graph not thin compositor only.
shared_requirements.S7: Exact FF/V553+ receiving use: direct empirical or learned input as its contract requires; actual output/refusal, temporal and semantic limits, consumer references and replay. Fix only demonstrated responsible interface.
shared_requirements.S8: Per-wave no-drop and actual production/consumer evidence; estate F6/F7/F8 composition and all35/1890/LongMemory tracked separately; no per-wave local pass promoted to full completion.

scope_law: Every wave must be accounted for; different source structures have different lawful workloads. No35 executions before representative milestone, no requirement for identical per-wave functions.
